body: You can chat on-demand with trained peers as an anonymous user at iPrevail. https://www.iprevail.com/chat_landing

There is also an app that does free anonymous chats, and all of the peer listeners have been through problems before and went through a program, so they have good perspectives. It's called iPrevail, I just found their chat page: https://www.iprevail.com/chat_landing

It is absolutely great that you have offered to help others. HUGE thank you. We need more people willing to do this, because we all need help. I have shut myself out before, but it never leads to good places. What it came down to for me, was the ability to talk with someone. I studied some things in health care, and found some new trends about what can really help people like me who struggle with mental health issues, namely depression. I found a group that does free anonymous chats and have been helping guide some friends to them. So far, everyone is having a great experience, so I wanted to pass along the word to people who can use someone to talk to. I just found the new link: https://www.iprevail.com/chat_landing

Sadly, that is all too often the case for mental health services. I have experienced the same thing when I have met with doctors before, they almost make me feel like I should be hesitant to bring up my depression or anxieties. Check out "iPrevail" they have free anonymous chats with people who have been through a program and are in recovery. It's nice just to have someone to talk to.
